description: Free. Call before paying an x402 seller. Returns allow / warn / block with reasons, the seller's current Lumi score and a link to the live report card. The verdict is signed by Lumi and verified locally against the Lumi keys pinned in this package (other keys are rejected). Only the URL's origin + path is sent. For MCP tool payments pass pay_to alone. If Lumi cannot be reached within 2.5 s the answer is warn (fail-open). Paying Lumi never changes a score, tier, ranking or 'Tested by Lumi' result. The paid 'Monitored by Lumi' badge is separate and labelled as paid.

network.description: CAIP-2 network, e.g. eip155:8453 or xrpl:0

pay_to.description: The payTo address from the 402 quote

url.description: The x402 resource URL you are about to pay
